Chhatrapati Gramvikas Bahuuddeshiya Sanstha (CGBS) works through practical, community-focused programmes in health, education, skills, tribal and rural development, women and youth empowerment, senior citizen welfare and social support.

7Key development areas

Health & Preventive Healthcare

Health camps, preventive healthcare awareness, health guidance and community support.

Education & Digital Education

Educational awareness, student learning support, career guidance and digital learning.

Tribal & Rural Development

Community awareness, empowerment and support activities in rural and tribal communities.

Women & Youth Empowerment

Women development, child support, youth skills, counselling and entrepreneurship initiatives.

Livelihood & Rural Enterprise

Vocational skills, entrepreneurship, agriculture, animal husbandry and rural livelihood support.

Environment, Relief & Welfare

Environment, water, sanitation, relief, rehabilitation, vulnerable-person and senior-citizen support.

Our Journey: 2005–Present

The programme record is organised into three phases.

2005–2018

41 programmes
Community development and social outreach across health, education, tribal & rural development, women & child empowerment, youth & skills, livelihoods, environment and relief/welfare.

2019–2022

13 initiatives
COVID-period community response including food and essential support, health and preventive awareness, sanitation-related awareness and support to vulnerable communities.

2023–Present

6 ongoing programmes
Elderly care, vulnerable women, family wellbeing, addiction awareness, athlete support and women's digital entrepreneurship.

Overall track record: 60 programmes / initiatives documented from 2005 to the present in the CGBS programme materials.
